rationale: The final verifier failed during Go test compilation, not due to a runtime semantic assertion. The decisive errors are type/API inconsistencies caused by the candidate changing the SDK model so JobCluster.NewCluster is a pointer, while the verifier-applied tests expect the v0.37.0 value-typed compute.ClusterSpec. The trajectory confirms the agent deliberately edited the local SDK copy to make NewCluster a pointer, creating the observed mismatch.

evidence.quote: cannot use compute.ClusterSpec{…} (value of type "github.com/databricks/databricks-sdk-go/service/compute".ClusterSpec) as *"github.com/databricks/databricks-sdk-go/service/compute".ClusterSpec value in struct literal
